messages.content: 將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？

function.name: thermodynamics_calc_gas_pressure
function.description: Calculate gas pressure in a closed chamber due to heating Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

volume.description: The volume of the chamber in cubic meters. This is a float type value.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the gas in degree Celsius. This is a float type value.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the gas in degree Celsius. This is a float type value.

initial_pressure.description: The initial pressure of the gas in Pascal. Default is standard atmospheric pressure. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning: The user asks: "將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？" They want to know how much gas will be produced? Actually they might mean the pressure increase? The question: "將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？" In Chinese: "How much gas will be produced when heating a 2 cubic meter sealed chamber from 25°C to 100°C?" That seems ambiguous. They might want to calculate the pressure change using ideal gas law. The function thermodynamics_calc_gas_pressure calculates gas pressure in a closed chamber due to heating. So we can call that function with volume=2, initial_temperature=25, final_temperature=100, initial_pressure default (standard atmospheric pressure). Then we get the final pressure. The question: "會產生多少氣體？" Actually "產生多少氣體" might be mis-phrased; maybe they want the pressure. We'll compute final pressure. Use function.
